items.title: SD-106 acceptance re-measurement at P0a epochs=40: does bottleneck variance preservation reach PCA-32 parity at the consumer rung on a raised budget?
items.note: SD-106's ACCEPTANCE RE-MEASUREMENT AT A RAISED P0a BUDGET -- the primary /queue-experiment routed by the CONFIRMED autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1041_2026-09-16 (recommended_writes_for_governance[10]; user gate 2026-09-16T13:06:22Z; applied by governance-20260916, REE_assembly db6d20ebee). | MANIPULATION: ONE integer -- ZWorldP0Config.epochs 12 -> 40 on the SD-106 P0a warmup (V3-EXQ-1041's b_steps1200 cell, which it executed 6 times). No new driver: this is a thin wrapper that overrides exactly two x1023 module functions (_warm_sd106_agent, _config_slice) and calls x1023.run_experiment unchanged, so every threshold, gate, anchor certificate and readout is the acceptance measurement's own code. preservation_weight stays 200.0 -- the V3-EXQ-1023 refusal to bump it STANDS. | ACCEPTANCE TARGET (pre-set by governance gov-20260911, NOT invented here, imported from x1023 rather than restated): >= 0.85 held-out oracle-action agreement at the consumer rung (x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN, arm zworld_sd106__mlp128) on a seed majority (2 of 3). C1 is the ONLY load-bearing criterion and is an ABSOLUTE bar against the PCA-32 anchor. | WHAT FALSIFIES WHAT: pre-registered predictions, RECORDED AND NOT ROUTED ON -- ~0.806 under H-transfer-amplification (the preservation code's extra world-obs content transfers monotonically to oracle-action agreement) vs ~0.719 under H-which-directions (it preserves more variance but not more decision-relevant direction); ~0.09 separation on the shipped DV. Both sit BELOW the 0.85 bar, so the likeliest outcome is a FAIL that still discriminates -- stated up front so a FAIL is not read as a wasted cycle. Both are EXISTING legs on the EXISTING question zworld_actor_adequacy_locus; this run opens no leg and edits no registry file. Verdict grid: C1 met on a seed majority -> PASS sd106_reaches_pca32_parity; C1 unmet -> FAIL sd106_below_pca32_parity; any declared control red (instrument rawfield floor, PCA-32 anchor, latent collapse, or the new budget precondition) -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a substrate verdict. | THE ONE-KNOB PROOF. resolve_p0a_config FORCES epochs=2 under --dry-run, so the smoke cannot witness epochs=40. It is proved instead by (a) --self-test asserting the non-dry resolved config is epochs=40 while the predecessor's default resolves to 12, and (b) a REAL-RUN precondition sd106_p0a_n_steps_supra_shipped that reads p0a_n_steps BACK OFF THE TRAINER on every SD-106 cell against a floor of 1000, scoped out (never failed) under --dry-run. The floor is certified at setup by assert_anchor_reachable against V3-EXQ-1041's own recorded cells (1320/1320/1160 at epochs=40; 396/396/348 at epochs=12), and the self-test carries the negative control that the floor REJECTS the shipped budget. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = oracle-action agreement at mlp128 on an SD-106-ON latent trained at P0a epochs=40. Checked V3-EXQ-1023 (ran the same instrument at epochs=12) and V3-EXQ-1041 (ran epochs=40 but is P0-warmup-only, no decoder ladder, DV is R^2 not agreement). No recorded manifest carries it on any substrate_hash -- NOT recoverable, run required. | Step 2.5 SD-106 IMPLEMENTED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md:426). Step 2.5a probe CONFIRMS the premise: resolve_p0a_config(dry_run=False, config=ZWorldP0Config(epochs=40)) resolves to epochs=40 with preservation_weight 200.0 intact, and use_world_encoder_skip reaches SplitEncoder. Step 2.5b re-derive brake on SD-106 = 0 hits. | Step 2.5c: MEASURED, not assumed. Of the four open corrupting substrate_queue entries on origin/master, three do NOT overlap this driver -- MECH-320 (policy/tonic_vigor.py), sd_blocked_agency_mismatch_floor_calibration (affect/blocked_agency.py) and sd105_frozen_shared_entropy_floor_multiplier (regulators/selection_entropy_floor.py) are imported but CONFIG-DISABLED on the x724 all-ON stack (use_tonic_vigor / use_blocked_agency / use_selection_entropy_floor all False, and agent.tonic_vigor / .blocked_agency / .selection_entropy_floor all None -- probed on a constructed agent). The ONE genuine overlap is contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write; agent.e1 is live), which is EXACTLY the entry covered by the SCOPED USER EXCEPTION of 2026-09-11 recorded verbatim in V3-EXQ-1023's own queue note -- granted because V3-EXQ-1010, the run governance pre-set as this acceptance measurement, already executed under it and the comparison is PAIRED. Same lineage, same instrument, same paired design; carried forward, not newly granted. Recorded so the manifest and any later autopsy see the limitation. | GFLAG-0286: x1010._best_over_rungs applies NO diverged-row filter. Disposition = REPORTED, NOT EXCLUDED (manifest diverged_cells + readout.n_diverged_cells). Excluding would change the instrument the acceptance target names as unchanged and break comparability with V3-EXQ-1023/1010; and the hazard cannot touch the verdict anyway, because C1 reads x1010._cell(rows, zworld_sd106__mlp128, seed) directly and never calls _best_over_rungs. | DV-SYMMETRY INVARIANCE, per track. The DV is held-out oracle-action agreement -- an argmax over a freshly-fitted decoder's logits, whose symmetry group is (per-candidate) order-preserving transforms of those logits. zworld_sd106: the manipulation changes the ENCODER'S OBJECTIVE AND BUDGET, hence the 32-dim input the decoder is fitted on, hence which function is learnable -- it is not a broadcast constant, a monotone rescaling of candidate scores, or a permutation of interchangeable units, so the DV is not invariant under it. zworld_off / ws250_pca / rawfield_ceiling are UNMANIPULATED reference tracks: they carry no manipulation to be invariant under, and exist to locate the bar and to prove the instrument can read the label at all. | PRE-REGISTERED LIMITATION (red-team F1, fixed documentarily and recorded machine-readably as manifest off_arm_budget): the OFF track is NOT budget-matched. x1010._warm_off_agent passes no zworld_p0_config (v3_exq_1010_...py:1087), so OFF trains at the default epochs=12. It is a shipped-budget REFERENCE, not a matched control, and every ON-minus-OFF delta in this manifest therefore confounds the preservation term with 3.3x more Adam steps. Those deltas are CONTEXT ONLY and nothing routes on them -- C1 is an absolute bar against a budget-independent PCA anchor and both discrimination predictions are agreement LEVELS, not deltas. NOT repaired by adding an OFF@40 arm because that is a new arm, outside the one-config-knob routing governance ratified, at ~33% more warmup compute, to de-confound a quantity nothing routes on; a budget-matched consumer-rung contrast is a successor letter. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 3 findings, ALL 3 FIXED, 0 dismissed, and each reviewer's own cheap confirmer shipped as a --self-test assertion. F1 the unmatched OFF budget (above); F2 _postprocess overwrote degeneracy_reason with 'the epochs=40 knob did not reach the trainer' when x1023's gate had short-circuited before ANY SD-106 cell ran, recording a false cause for a later autopsy -> the override now fires only when SD-106 cells actually ran, and a scoped-out C3 declares threshold_not_applicable instead of a numeric bar the indexer would recompute MET from; F3 _worst_p0a_steps silently dropped a cell that reported no p0a_n_steps, so two good seeds plus one refused seed recorded measured=1320 passed=True -> a non-reporting cell now scores as 0 (the worst cell), keeping `measured` the same statistic `met` tests. | V3-EXQ-1041 context carried in manifest prior_evidence_context rather than re-measured: the in-training preservation_holdout.r2 is a jointly-SGD-trained head metric that UNDER-READS the same code on the same buffer and split by 0.0979/0.0967/0.1289 absolute R^2 and is a LOWER BOUND; the post-hoc OLS probe (0.951 as-shipped -> 0.980 at this budget, of the in-run PCA-32 ceiling) is CITED from V3-EXQ-1041, which measured exactly this cell, and NOT recomputed here -- building it needs that run's observation-capture apparatus, a second instrument rather than a config knob; the SD-106 design doc's 0.9974/0.9978 obs-R^2 table is on a DIFFERENT observation distribution (PCA-32 of the P0a buffer reaches only 0.888 held-out / 0.893 in-sample on seed 42, cross-seed held-out median 0.886), so those absolutes are not comparable to any P0a acceptance number; and V3-EXQ-1041's shortfall decomposition is ORDER-DEPENDENT -- metric-first routes metrics_never_comparable, budget-first routes under_budgeted_p0a (budget 0.769 median), order-symmetric routes its own tie branch no_dominant_explanation (metric 0.404 / budget 0.475 / residual 0.104) -- all three recorded so no reader treats either partition as settled. | SUPERSESSION: `supersedes: V3-EXQ-1023` is provenance only. Per CLAUDE.md, a bare `supersedes` hands nothing to governance, so a governance_flag (evidence_discrepancy) is raised separately for /governance to decide whether V3-EXQ-1023's evidence_direction becomes `superseded`. Both runs are experiment_purpose=diagnostic and already excluded from confidence/conflict scoring. | experiment_purpose=diagnostic, stated not assumed: this DOES re-measure a pre-set acceptance target, but re-measuring a SUBSTRATE acceptance target is a READINESS verdict on a landed design decision (/implement-substrate Step 8), not governance evidence for a mechanism hypothesis -- SD-106 is a design decision, a PASS routes a BUILD decision, and comparability with the predecessor this run supersedes requires the same class. PROMOTES NOTHING on its own.

items.title: SD-082 successor (H1-trained-discriminating-readout): the first CONSEQUENCE-TRAINED lateral_pfc rule readout -- with modulatory selection authority ON and gated_policy OFF during P1, does the trained readout change E3's top preference (argmin) MORE than the same substrate's frozen-init readout, tick for tick on the same yoked observation stream (per-seed paired exact test, minimal effect 0.05)?
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring). The SD-082 successor routed by CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1027-1029-cluster_2026-09-14 (applied by governance 2026-09-15, REE_assembly beb47bca09) off V3-EXQ-1029 -- registry leg H1-trained-discriminating-readout under a CHANGED training regime: the first SD-082 run with lateral_pfc_rule_readout_consumer=True AND use_modulatory_selection_authority=True during P1, so the head's output enters the selection whose outcome REINFORCE credits. New EXQ NUMBER, no supersedes: 1029a is refused BY NAME in the autopsy's release_basis, and 1029 is a confirmed load-bearing PASS that nothing here invalidates. P1 budget 300 from failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1028_2026-09-15 (status awaiting_human_confirmation -- cited as PROVISIONAL; this run records its own per-half update/flip-tick profile, measured at 1020's pre-update point, so the budget is re-readable in its own regime). | DESIGN: per seed five yoked runners on private torch/numpy/random streams, all stepped on the reference's observation: TRAINED_INTACT (reference, drives env, head REINFORCE-updated), TRAINED_ABLATED (same head, rule_state zeroed for compute_bias), INIT_INTACT / INIT_ABLATED (head held at P0-end weights), REF_SELF (bit-identical twin). Head state_dict mirrored into the trained siblings after every update; agents are never deep-copied. On every score tick where all four pair runners are fresh and both pairs raw-identical, a joint 2x2 table is accumulated: b = trained pair diverges in argmin(post-bias scores) and init pair does not, c = the reverse, n = all such ticks; paired DV per seed = (b-c)/n. gated_policy OFF on all five runners (the autopsy's authority_channel_confound control) and R7 MEASURES that the readout is the sole modulatory contributor (E3 composite modulatory range vs the head's own bias range per fresh tick); modulatory_authority_gain 0.5 (1029's, so the init pair is comparable to 1029's banked on_pair; the 2.0 prior art disposed of in the docstring); NO magnitude arm -- and under authority the applied modulatory range is normalised per runner, so the DV is a bias SHAPE comparison, stated as such. Seeds = 5 lineage [611,622,633,644,655] + 2 FRESH [666,677], a pre-registered factor (C3). P0=60, P1=300, SCORE=60 at 48 steps. E3 never commits in this configuration (committed_fraction 0.0) so the DV is E3's TOP PREFERENCE, not an executed action; sampled-action divergence recorded per pair. | CRITERIA (per-seed paired exact test, adjudicated over READY seeds, SEED_MAJORITY 4 of 7 ABSOLUTE, ONE effect bound M = MIN_EFFECT_OF_INTEREST 0.05 for all three so they partition each seed's outcome): C1 (load-bearing) P[Bin(b+c,1/2)>=b] < 0.05 AND DV >= M on >= 4 seeds AND mean DV >= M -> PASS/supports; C1neg (routing) the mirror at -M -> FAIL/weakens (training reduced the readout's consequence; per-seed c1neg_reachable = init reach inside the joint table >= M is recorded, since DV >= -init); C4 (routing) two-sided equivalence -M < LB95 and UB95 < M on EVERY ready seed AND |mean DV| < M, evaluated only when neither C1 nor C1neg fired -> FAIL/weakens (label distinguishes a significant sub-M advantage from no detectable advantage); otherwise FAIL/unknown (inconclusive or heterogeneous; sign, per-seed p-values, bounds, run and episode counts recorded). C2 (trained pair >= 0.02 on a majority) is RECORDED, not load-bearing -- proved implied by C1 under R5; C3 (a FRESH seed among the C1-clearing seeds) refines a PASS only. combination_rule in the manifest. Readiness PER SEED via experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py: R1 self-yoke 0 divergent; R2 INIT head flip >= 0.01 (the trained head's flip fraction is a RESULT, recorded); R3 authority active >= 0.5 on the two INIT runners (all four recorded with an equality flag); R4 joint paired n >= 50 (all four runners fresh AND all four raw score vectors identical -- the two pairs on the same raw landscape; mismatches counted); R5 init reach INSIDE the joint table >= 0.02 (1029's DIV_FLOOR, comparator '>=' explicit); R6 >= 200 updates AND head_move_l2 > 1e-6; R7 sole-channel relative difference <= 1e-3 with post-authority exploration channels counted as misses. MIN_READY_SEEDS 4; fewer = refusal with a record whose label names the dominant red gate (R5 -> substrate_not_ready_requeue; fewer than 4 seeds RUN -> insufficient_seeds_run) and whose summary states exact per-seed counts; interpretation.preconditions carries green seeds only when adjudicated, with the library's scope note at the key the indexer reads (the V3-EXQ-785 rule). | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = paired trained-minus-init argmin divergence with consumer=True and authority ON; the cluster autopsy searched the ~50 ARC-062/GAP-B authority-trained drivers (none with the SD-082 consumer) and the whole 822*/1020/1027/1028/1029 lineage (authority OFF) -> not recoverable, run. 1029's recorded on_pair (0.2615/0.0271/0.0144/0.0821/0.1155) reused as the design-time feasibility prior. | Step 2.5/2.5a: consumer flag, authority flag and the compute_bias / select_action / lateral_pfc.update hooks all reachable at runtime (scale probes below). | Step 2.5b re-derive brake: consumer count for SD-082 = 3 (822b/822c/822d) >= 2; NOT braked -- both producer autopsies stamp fired=false with literal_count_meets_threshold=true (explicit release: none of the counted readings is a substrate_ceiling, no build is owed), and three skill exemptions apply independently (new EXQ number, changed manipulation/regime, diagnostic discriminating WHY). | Step 2.5c: SD-082 substrate_queue entry is corrupting with substrate_paths [] (emptied by governance 2026-09-09, recorded UNCHANGED by both autopsies) -> cannot fire; no open corrupting entry with a populated path names e3_selector.py or lateral_pfc_analog.py; DEGRADING entries on this footprint recorded: SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING, mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism (causal_grid_world.py); the authority flag is implemented_pending_validation and is the MANIPULATED variable, disclosed as such. | Ethics all-false/allow (SENT-0). | DV-SYMMETRY per arm: DV = paired argmin-divergence difference, invariant under a constant broadcast across candidates and a monotone rescale of the whole score vector; the ablation changes the head's INPUT through a nonlinear per-candidate MLP (R2 measures the flip on the init head; a trained head whose bias has become a broadcast is what C1neg/C2 read out), head_effect changes its WEIGHTS (R6 asserts they differ), the self-yoke carries no manipulation; authority is NOT a symmetry of this DV (it rescales the modulatory vector, not the whole score) and the design no longer claims it is -- it fixes the applied modulatory RANGE per runner, which is why the comparison is one of shape. | Sample size: 1029's _choose clears e3.last_* before every select_action and gates fresh on it; n_fresh per runner, per-pair raw-identical counts and the joint n recorded; runner summaries are score-phase only. REINFORCE surrogate is 1020's log_softmax(-bias/T) over the head's own output, unchanged -- a negative weakens H1 AS OPERATIONALISED BY THIS LINEAGE'S PROCEDURE; the surrogate form stays a named residual alternative (config.reinforce.surrogate). | SCALE PROBES (seed 611, p0=12 p1=25 score=20 at 24 steps): pre-redesign 552 s -- R5 init pair 12/60 = 0.20 GREEN (the readout DOES reach E3's argmin in this regime), trained pair 0/60, trained head flip 0.00 vs init 0.115, authority scale median 131, committed_fraction 0.0, 25 updates; post-redesign 452 s -- joint b=1 c=11 n=60, paired DV -0.167, p_neg 0.0032, UB95 -0.079 (c1neg_seed True), init 0.183 / trained 0.017 / head_effect 0.867, INIT flip 0.125, trained flip 0.00, R7 sole-channel rel diff 0.0 median and max on 60 ticks, authority active 1.0, 24 updates (R6a red at probe scale only), head_move_l2 0.266, every other gate green. Probe-driven changes before the red-team: crash fix (the H-learning-signal-sign statistic unpacked 1020's 3-tuples as pairs; invisible to the dry run, which reaches no update); explicit comparators on every precondition (the indexer's inclusive default would recompute an R5 reading of exactly 0.0 as met). | red-team pass 1 (opus): BLOCKING, 17 findings -- F2-A C2 implied by C1 under R5 (FIXED: C2 demoted, unreachable null-table row removed); F2-B/F2-C the across-seed-SD null margin made the trained-collapses-to-zero negative unreachable at the banked prior (CV 0.99) and degenerated to the absolute floor at low SD (FIXED: replaced by the per-seed paired exact test; legacy margin recorded only); F3-A `weakens` stamped on a positive near-miss (FIXED: sign-aware grid, C1neg / C4 / unknown); F4-B all-seeds readiness vs majority criteria (FIXED: per-seed gates, MIN_READY_SEEDS 4, green-only adjudication list); F1-B authority divides out magnitude and the docstring's scalar-rescale symmetry argument was false (FIXED in prose: shape comparison); F1-C sole channel asserted not measured (FIXED: R7); F1-D surrogate still the imitation form (SCOPED); F1-E "committed preference" false (FIXED); F1-F raw-identical filter vacuous under yoking (FIXED prose); F1-G P1 flip measured post-update (FIXED: pre-update hook); F3-B refusal prose (FIXED: counts); F3-C C3 vacuous + blanket non-degeneracy (FIXED: C3 = fresh-seed-reproduces, applies on PASS only; per-criterion); F3-D console verdict (FIXED); F4-A (resolved by F2-B's fix); F4-D R3 provenance (NOTED); F1-A/F4-C CLEAN. Self-test now executes 9 synthetic grid branches (PASS main / lineage-only / weakens-reduced / weakens-equivalence / unknown / PASS on 4 ready of 7 / R5 refusal / R6 refusal / 3-significant-seeds-not-PASS) before any compute. | red-team pass 2 (opus): CONTESTED, 14 findings, no BLOCKING -- all fixed or dismissed in writing (docstring RED-TEAM RECORD): F-1 C1/C4 not exclusive and F-3 C1 floor below the minimal effect (FIXED: one bound M for C1/C1neg per seed and mean, two-sided C4; exclusivity swept exhaustively in the self-test); F-2 C4 seizable by strongly negative seeds (FIXED: universal over ready seeds, |mean| < M, after C1/C1neg; the F-2 shape now routes unknown); F-4 R5 '>0' at n~300 admitted C1neg-blind seeds and F-5 R5 on the wrong denominator (FIXED: R5 inside the joint table at 1029's 0.02; c1neg_reachable per seed); F-6 independence statistics dropped (FIXED: 1029's run stats restored, joint runs + episode counts, min discordant on clearing seeds); F-7 C4 non-degeneracy (DISMISSED with note: R5-on-joint guarantees init reach on every ready seed); F-8 scope note not at the indexer's key (FIXED); F-9 realised-n refusal routing and untested gate_red (FIXED: insufficient_seeds_run branch + grid cases); F-10 cross-pair raw landscape (FIXED: required, mismatches counted); F-11 R7 blind to post-authority channels (FIXED: active-flag check); F-12 hook fires in the REINFORCE replay (FIXED: captures cleared per step); F-13 R3 gated on trained runners (FIXED: INIT only); F-14 title carried the withdrawn margin (FIXED). Clean checks 1-9 recorded. No third pass (one re-spawn permitted, spent after pass 1). Self-test now executes 13 grid branches + the exclusivity sweep.. | Smoke on the final driver: --dry-run PASS end-to-end (self-test 13 branches, `Seed S Condition C` boundary, `ep N/M` with M=p0+p1+score, per-seed `[seed]` line + one `verdict:` line per seed, manifest relocated, sentinel emitted); at dry scale (1 seed) it correctly self-labels insufficient_seeds_run. validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings, no exemption markers; validate_recording.py --strict on the dry manifest OK (33 flat readout scalars, criteria carry measured+threshold, comparator on every precondition, scope note present, arm_fingerprint reuse_eligible). ASCII 0 violations. Post-pass-2 scale probe: 749 s, every gate green except R6a (24 updates vs the 200 floor that 300 P1 episodes reach): joint b=1 c=11 both=0 n=60, init reach inside the joint table 0.183 (R5 >= 0.02), paired DV -0.167, p_neg 0.0032, LB95/UB95 -0.255/-0.079 (c1neg_seed True, c1neg_reachable True, equivalence False), the 11 c-ticks in 9 runs across 9 distinct episodes (not clustered), cross_pair_raw_mismatch 0, post_authority_channel_ticks 0, R7 0.0 median and max on 60 ticks, authority active 1.0 on all four runners (equal), head_move_l2 0.266, INIT flip 0.125, trained flip 0.00, |bias| trained 0.012 vs init 0.023, committed_fraction 0.0.. | Runtime: probe-calibrated ~950 min on darwin-arm64 for 7 x 420 episodes; 1000 min queued. | Authored by science-batch4-20260915-exq-1046 (metaworker Orchestrator, died on the 2026-09-16 weekly limit mid red-team); resumed, redesigned and queued by busy-goodall-364bc0 (chip-20260916-resume-exq1046-sd082-consequence-readout-queue). Sibling V3-EXQ-1044 untracked in the shared checkout at authoring time, deliberately NOT staged.

items.title: ARC-131/SD-091: does channel commensurability make coalition recruitment scale-invariant?
items.note: ARC-131 / SD-091: does E3's divisive channel normalisation make endogenous coalition recruitment SCALE-invariant, or is a scale-relative coalition threshold still owed? Routed by the CONFIRMED autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1038_2026-09-14, user gate 2026-09-16T12:22:00Z, applied by governance-20260916 (REE_assembly db6d20ebee; substrate_queue SD-091 amended, node_class `complex (probe-gated)` GATED ON THIS RUN -- this design unblocks SD-091's next decision, it is not blocked by it). | MANIPULATION: ONE swept factor, E3Config.use_e3_channel_commensurability OFF (V3-EXQ-1038's condition) vs ON. No new substrate code. 7 seeds, paired, fresh env + full RNG reset per cell. HELD FIXED: the shipped endogenous_coalition_margin_threshold=0.05 (never overridden), the agent/env construction, coalition_max_duration_ticks=50, and the 1e6 guaranteed-fire control. | ENABLE-PATH HAZARD, measured not assumed: use_e3_channel_commensurability is an E3Config field (config.py:1073) and is NOT a from_dims parameter, so REEConfig.from_dims(use_e3_channel_commensurability=True) is SILENTLY SWALLOWED (the attribute does not exist on the result) and setting it on the top-level REEConfig is also a no-op, because REEAgent builds the selector from config.e3 (agent.py:409). The only working path is cfg.e3.use_e3_channel_commensurability, and _build() ASSERTS it landed on agent.e3.config -- without that the ON arm would be a bit-identical copy of OFF with no error anywhere (memory reference-reeconfig-from-dims-silent-kwargs). | WHAT FALSIFIES WHAT. F1 (absolute pre-registered bar from V3-EXQ-1038's published 605.7x): the ON arm's cross-seed median-margin max/min ratio < 10.0. F2 (absolute pre-registered bar from V3-EXQ-1038's own |rho| = 0.830): the ON arm's |Spearman rho| between per-seed median E3 margin (SCALE) and per-seed eligibility fraction (RECRUITMENT) < 0.40. F1 AND F2 -> normalisation suffices, no SD-091 build owed. NEITHER -> an INFORMATIVE null that discharges SD-091's probe gate but is explicitly NOT an automatic build authorisation: two readings remain and this run does not separate them (threshold-needs-to-be-scale-relative vs the-operator's-own-divisor), so it routes to /failure-autopsy with per-cell within_cell_margin_dispersion and chan_scale_ema_final recorded for exactly that adjudication. EXACTLY ONE -> partial, /failure-autopsy. Plus a distinct branch: ON mean eligibility <= 0.01 -> commensurability_eliminates_eligibility (normalisation stopped recruitment rather than making it scale-invariant), which must not be read as the suffices outcome. | DV CHANGED FROM THE PREDECESSOR, and this is the load-bearing design fact. V3-EXQ-1038 reported recruitment as a per-episode REQUEST COUNT. That count is RATE-CAPPED by the coalition debounce: should_dissolve is timeout-only (coalition_controller.py:143, >= 50) and the trigger runs BEFORE coalition.tick() in the same select_action, so the earliest re-request is 51 ticks later on a 10-tick E3 grid -- the attainable maximum and the arithmetic ceiling scale together and NO episode length creates headroom. MEASURED here: seed 5 comm_off reached [4, 4] against a ceiling of 5 at 250 ticks. A first draft GATED on that count and would have self-routed the entire run to substrate_not_ready_requeue on a mechanism cap misread as an instrument defect. The DV is now the ELIGIBILITY FRACTION (fraction of fresh E3 margin samples below 0.05) -- uncapped, and exactly the quantity V3-EXQ-1038 found recruitment to track. Measured seed 5: 0.938 (OFF) vs 0.328 (ON). The request count stays RECORDED with an explicit request_count_rate_cap block saying nothing routes on it. | EIGHT PRECONDITIONS, split into INSTRUMENT and PREMISE gates. Instrument (red -> substrate_not_ready_requeue): G0 every arm x seed 1e6 control fires; G1 the operator's raw terms dict is non-empty on every ON cell and empty on every OFF cell; G1b every ON cell's _chan_scale_n reaches the warmup (e3_selector.py:1372 returns an EXACT 1.0 below it, so the operator reports as engaged while being a no-op -- the FIRST smoke hit this and returned bit-identical arms, 0.21258544921875 on both; measured resolution: chan_scale_n 75 at 600 ticks gives OFF 0.13548 vs ON 0.17944); G1c the ON and OFF median margins DIFFER on every seed (the mechanical form of the DV-symmetry declaration -- equal medians would make F1/F2 arithmetic identities); G2 every cell collected >= 50% of the fresh-margin samples its schedule implies.
